newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Asia Capital, Vanik suspended on takeover news.
newsitem.headline: Asia Capital, Vanik suspended on takeover news.

text.p: Trading in shares of investment banks Asia Capital Ltd and Vanik Incorporation Ltd have been suspended, following a takeover offer announced on Tuesday, stock exchange officials said.

Asia Capital Ltd said it had offered to buy all the issued shares of Vanik Incorporation Limited as of November 11, on the basis of 10 rupees in cash and one new share of Asia Capital for each of Vanik's more than 40 million shares.
"We will lift the suspension after the mid-morning break, as one session should be enough to disseminate the information to the public," said a spokesman for the Colombo Stock Exchange.
